description: List the school's users, newest first (20 per page by default), filterable by status, role, tags, registration date and custom fields. All filters are ANDed. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users.

custom_fields.description: Custom-field filters, e.g. {"cf_skill": "Excel"}. The cf_ prefix is added if missing.

registration_after.description: Registered after (Unix timestamp in seconds, e.g. 1626088013).

registration_before.description: Registered before (Unix timestamp in seconds, e.g. 1626088013).

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; users with these tags.

name: learnworlds_list_users
title: List users
